Search four offer pairs for old player ID after the inventory write; clear offer ID and copy threshold to inventory trade_value, using+8/+9 on miss. Exact table aliasing observes earlier writes. Clear NPC ready, announce, copy old player ID to NPC selection, refresh names, clear all world-object readiness bits. Keep existing eight-byte owners.
